slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: Good skin tones survive platform compression

slides.heading: VECTORSCOPE SKIN LINE
slides.caption: Keep skin values aligned with the skin tone line.

slides.heading: WORKFLOW
steps: Open the vectorscope and isolate the skin region.
Adjust hue and saturation in small increments.
Use qualifiers only when global adjustments fail.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Check skin under multiple lighting angles—grading for one angle can break another.
